# Vision fixture

person-no-hardhat.png: NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins, distributed as scikit-image's astronaut example, public domain NASA image.
Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png

This is a **non-construction portrait** used only to exercise the image-to-PPE-observation pathway. Detecting a missing hardhat in this picture is not evidence of a legal violation or validated site-safety accuracy. Do not present it as construction footage.

blank.png is a generated uniform-color 128×128 image used for the zero-worker consistency test. It contains no people or user data.
